adjudication.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the code does `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no try/catch. Both `symmetricDecrypt(...)` (bad ciphertext/wrong key) and `JSON.parse(...)` (non-JSON plaintext) can throw, which would bubble out of the handler and result in an unhandled server error (500) rather than a controlled 4xx response. This risk is directly visible in the added code path and is not otherwise guarded by zod validation (since `keys` is only validated as `z.string()`).
